item.title: Write the Cleanup Headline

turns.text: Make a square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly illustrated seaside scene, with a short catchy headline — you pick the words. No dates or signup details.

item.tests: Checks that the agent writes and renders a suitable headline rather than asking the user for wording or omitting text.

answer_sheet.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

must_haves: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
No dates or signup details appear.

turns.text: Could you make a social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach? I like the idea of giving people a little nudge to care for the coast, because it can feel like a small thing that actually matters. For the scene, I’m thinking a friendly seaside illustration, and the graphic should be square. It should have a short, catchy headline, but I’m happy for you to pick the words. I always overthink wording on things like this, so handing that part over is a relief. Please don’t include any dates or signup details.

style.prompt: Create a polished square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly seaside editorial illustration with warm textured paper, soft rounded shapes, cheerful coastal colors: seafoam green, turquoise water, sandy cream, coral and sunny yellow. A few friendly neighbors collect small pieces of litter into reusable cleanup bags along a beautiful local beach, with gentle waves, dune grass and a seabird. Show care, community and how small acts matter, not an overwhelmed or polluted landscape. Strong clear graphic composition with generous uncluttered space for headline in upper third, illustrated cleanup scene below. Include exactly this headline in large bold beautifully readable playful lettering: "Small Acts. Cleaner Coasts." This is the only text. No dates, no signup details, no logos, no other words. Inviting, optimistic, approachable, professional illustration suitable for social media.
